snippet.title: Halo New Covenant | Trailer
snippet.description:
A campaign mod for Halo 3 ODST, Halo New Covenant takes you on a journey after the events of Halo 3 in a new direction.

3 Missions complete, a 4th on the way, available the 31st Jan on the steam workshop for Halo 3 ODST. For single player and up to 4 player coop.

Join the official discord here: https://discord.gg/p3AC7ns9sp

If you'd like to support this project consider becoming a patreon here for extra updates and perks: https://www.patreon.com/c/halonc

Or if you prefer a one off financial thank you buy me a coffee here: buymeacoffee.com/halonc
